percent_by_class.specified_offences: up to 50% relief on the pending fine

order_ref: Notification No. 3261 dated 30 April 2026 (e-gazette; recorded in the Patna High Court order of 4 May 2026)
note: Bihar's one-time settlement took effect at the 9 May 2026 National Lok Adalat under Patna High Court supervision and remains operational through financial year 2026-27. It gives up to 50% relief on e-challans pending more than 90 days for specified offences; serious violations such as using a handheld mobile while driving are excluded and attract the full penalty. Settlement happens at National Lok Adalat sittings. The Patna High Court's 4 May 2026 order records the notification (No. 3261 dated 30 April 2026), but the notification text itself is not online — the up-to-50% figure is as reported in press, so confirm the relief shown against your challan on the official portal before paying.
